features.name: Modern Search
features.description: A new search mechanism that searches for all words rather than any substring within a word, providing significantly faster search results and matching user expectations from other search engines. Applies to page search, lookup, and company-wide search.
caveats: Requires optimized for text search property to be enabled on table fields
Legacy search still available via star prefix
Behavior changes based on user enabling modern search and field optimization

features.name: optimized for text search Property
features.description: A new table field property that enables modern search functionality on specific fields. Should be applied to primary key fields, descriptive text fields, and identifying fields that users want to search on.
caveats: Should not be added to fields where there are thousands of rows or grouping mechanisms
Can be applied on both table fields and table extension fields

features.name: Modern Search in Item Lists
features.description: Modern search functionality applied to item lookup pages, allowing users to search for items by word without requiring exact substring matching or specific punctuation, with significantly improved performance.
caveats: Legacy search can still be enabled and used with star prefix syntax
Word order does not matter in search

features.name: Double And Filter Operator
features.description: New filter operator for the set filter method in the record API that enables full-text search matching on fields with optimized for text search property enabled.
caveats: Falls back to case-insensitive contain search if field does not have optimized for text search enabled
Syntax can be complex when combining multiple search terms
Behavior changes based on whether modern search is enabled and field optimization

features.name: Full-Text Search Index Generation
features.description: The synchronization engine automatically generates and regenerates a full-text search index for tables when indexed fields are added or changed. Creates one index per table using neutral language word breakers.
caveats: Index is language independent using only standard word breakers like space and dash
Creates one index per table with indexed fields

features.name: Star Prefix for Legacy Search
features.description: Users can prefix search queries with a double star to force legacy substring-based search behavior instead of modern word-based search, useful for finding partial IDs or when legacy behavior is preferred.
caveats: Legacy search is slower than modern search
Available in page search, lookup, and company-wide search

features.name: Company-wide Search with Modern Search
features.description: Modern search functionality extends to company-wide search across all data, using modern search for fields with optimized for text search property while maintaining existing behavior for non-indexed fields.
caveats: Fields without optimized for text search property still use legacy search behavior
Performance may vary depending on which fields are indexed
